text: The mountain behind me just exploded. This is Pompeii.
My part is made up. Everything around me is true.
This morning was ordinary. A town of eleven thousand people. Fresh bread at the baker's.
A guard dog on his chain, and a floor that says: beware of the dog.
The ground has been shaking for days. Nobody worries. Here, it always shakes.
A cloud climbs out of it like a pine tree: a tall trunk, then branches.
The baker runs. The soldier runs. The merchant grabs his coins. I grab my cap.
Then the sky starts to fall. Not rain. Stones.
And in the middle of the day, it goes dark. That is part two.
